column1: # Magento <-> dependency compatibility matrix. Single source of truth for
# bin/init -- read by lib/versions.sh, which every bin/ script relies on so
# there's never more than one place that knows these numbers.
# Source: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/commerce-operations/installation-guide/system-requirements
# (cross-checked against the "php" platform constraint in magento/magento2's
# composer.json for each tag, and against setup/.../SearchConfigOptionsList.php
# for which search-engine options each version actually ships).
# Columns are TAB-separated:
#   version        Magento version, as a boundary-aware prefix (see versions_prefix_match
#   php            Comma-separated list of officially supported PHP versions. The first
#                  one listed becomes the suggested default at the init prompt.
#   mariadb        MariaDB image tag to run for this Magento version. Auto-selected --
#                  never prompted for.
#   opensearch     OpenSearch image tag to run when the OpenSearch engine is chosen, or
#                  "-" if this version's `setup:install --search-engine=` has no
#                  "opensearch" value at all (bin/init then never offers it).
#   elasticsearch  Elasticsearch image tag to run when the Elasticsearch engine is chosen,
#                  or "-" if Adobe does not list Elasticsearch as supported for this
#                  version (bin/init then refuses that choice with an error).
#   composer       Composer version to install into the php image.
# Rows are matched top-to-bottom; the first match wins. Keep more specific prefixes
# above less specific ones (every prefix below is currently disjoint, so order is not
# load-bearing yet, but a future "2.4" catch-all row would need to go last).
# A native "opensearch" engine value was only added to `setup:install` in 2.4.6 (see
# setup/src/Magento/Setup/Model/SearchConfigOptionsList.php at each git tag -- 2.4.4
# and 2.4.5 only ever list elasticsearch5/6/7, on every patch level up to the last one
# mirrored on GitHub). Adobe's system-requirements page still lists "OpenSearch 2.19"
# for 2.4.4/2.4.5 because OpenSearch 2.x is wire-compatible with the ES 7.x client
# Magento uses there -- you can point that same elasticsearch7 engine at an OpenSearch
# host and it works, but there's no distinct "opensearch" value to pass, so bin/init
# doesn't offer it as a separate choice for those two versions (elasticsearch is the
# only -- and correct -- option there). Elasticsearch's own version column below drives
# the `--search-engine=elasticsearch<major>` value bin/init passes (see bin/init) --
# always keep it as an actual "<major>.<minor>.<patch>" tag, never a bare major number.
# version
2.4-develop
